home.title: FFGui - Media Toolbox
home.cardConvertDesc: Convert between MP4 / MKV / MP3 and other formats

convert.title: Convert Audio/Video - FFGui
convert.heading: Convert Audio/Video
convert.capsLoading: Detecting ffmpeg capabilities (hardware acceleration / encoders / muxers)…
convert.fileEmpty: No files yet — click “Add files” or drag audio/video files here
convert.presetTipDefault: A device preset locks the output parameters (format / encoder / frame rate / resolution / bitrate); pick a preset to see its specification here.
convert.phAudioTrack: e.g. 2: keep only the 2nd audio track
convert.checkSampleOnly: Only encode the first 30 seconds (verify on the target device first)
convert.hintAudioTrackRule: Track indices start at 1 for each input file. Multi-track MP3, FLAC, WAV and FLV inputs require an explicit track; existing files are avoided and never overwritten.
convert.labelVbitrate: Video bitrate (kbps, empty = follow quality level)
convert.pixFmtAuto: Auto (may keep the source bit depth)
convert.phFps: Auto / keep source frame rate, or enter a number
convert.checkPreserveMetadata: Keep text tags (fields supported by the target format)
convert.checkPreserveCover: Keep embedded cover art (MP3 / M4A / FLAC)
convert.modalTip: Unspecified parameters use defaults. The pixel format must be supported by the selected encoder; Profile / Level apply to libx264 only. Lowering the Level does not shrink the picture or reduce the frame rate. Cover art and text tags are preserved separately; custom fields are not guaranteed to map across formats.
convert.capsInfo: ffmpeg {{version}} | {{hw}} hardware acceleration methods, {{venc}} video encoders and {{aenc}} audio encoders detected
convert.labelFpsPreset: Output frame rate (max {{fps}} fps, lower rates preserved)
convert.logBadFps: Invalid frame rate; enter a number between 1 and 240 (e.g. 24, 23.976), or leave it empty to keep the source frame rate
convert.tipIpod: iPod touch 4 / iOS 6: MP4 · H.264 Main 3.1 · 8-bit · keep aspect ratio · up to 30 fps · AAC stereo 128 kbps; track 1 is used by default, and you can pick another. The preset locks compatible parameters; check the specs of other models. 10-bit is not necessarily HDR, so choose tone mapping according to the source file.
convert.tipBili1080: Bilibili 1080P upload: MP4 · H.264 High 4.2 · keep aspect ratio · up to 60 fps · average 6000 kbps (peak 12000) · AAC 320 kbps/48 kHz. A 6000 kbps average is the platform's re-encode-free ceiling; track 1 is used by default, and you can pick another.
convert.tipBili720: Bilibili 720P upload: MP4 · H.264 High 3.1 · keep aspect ratio · up to 30 fps · average 3000 kbps (peak 6000) · AAC 192 kbps/48 kHz; track 1 is used by default, and you can pick another.
convert.tipDouyin1080: Douyin/Kuaishou 1080P: MP4 · H.264 High 4.2 · keep aspect ratio · up to 60 fps · average 6000 kbps (peak 12000) · AAC 192 kbps/48 kHz. The platform recommends 2–8 Mbps; check the aspect ratio of portrait sources.
convert.tipWechat1080: WeChat Channels 1080P: MP4 · H.264 High 4.0 · keep aspect ratio · up to 30 fps · average 4000 kbps (peak 8000) · AAC 128 kbps/48 kHz; track 1 is used by default, and you can pick another.
convert.tipYoutube1080: YouTube 1080P: MP4 · H.264 High 4.2 · keep aspect ratio · up to 60 fps · average 8000 kbps (peak 12000) · AAC 384 kbps/48 kHz. Matches the official upload recommendation (1080p30 8 Mbps / 1080p60 12 Mbps).
convert.tipIphone4s: iPhone 4S / iOS 6: MP4 · H.264 High 4.0 · keep aspect ratio · up to 30 fps · average 4000 kbps (peak 8000) · AAC 160 kbps/48 kHz. This is Apple's official 1080p playback ceiling (High ≤4.0, AAC-LC ≤160 kbps); track 1 is used by default, and you can pick another.
convert.tipPsp: PSP: MP4 · H.264 Main 2.2 · keep aspect ratio · 480×272 · up to 30 fps · average 1000 kbps (peak 1500) · AAC 128 kbps/48 kHz; track 1 is used by default, and you can pick another.
convert.tipAndroidLegacy: Legacy Android (2.x era): MP4 · H.264 Baseline 2.1 · keep aspect ratio · 800×480 · up to 30 fps · average 1000 kbps (peak 1500) · AAC 128 kbps/44.1 kHz; track 1 is used by default, and you can pick another.
convert.tipWebSafe: Maximum compatibility: MP4 · H.264 Baseline 3.0 · keep aspect ratio · 720p · up to 30 fps · average 2500 kbps (peak 5000) · AAC 128 kbps/44.1 kHz. Good for web embedding and old players; track 1 is used by default, and you can pick another.
convert.tipTv4k: 4K TV / box (also Bilibili 4K upload): MP4 · H.264 High 5.1 · keep aspect ratio · 2160p · up to 30 fps · average 20000 kbps (peak 40000) · AAC 192 kbps/48 kHz. A 20000 kbps average is Bilibili's 4K re-encode-free ceiling; track 1 is used by default, and you can pick another.

merge.title: Merge Audio & Video - FFGui
merge.heading: Merge Audio & Video
merge.queueEmpty: No files yet — click “Add files” or drag audio/video files here
merge.tipQueue: Tip: an audio-only queue outputs audio only; when the queue contains video, audio files are merged in as a black-screen video.
merge.subtitleEmpty: No subtitle yet — drag a .srt / .ass / .ssa / .vtt file here
merge.subModeEmbed: Embed subtitle track (soft subs, can be toggled)
merge.tipSubtitle: Tip: the subtitle timeline must match the whole merged video; a warning appears before starting when the durations differ. One video plus one subtitle is enough to start.
merge.phAudioTrack: e.g. 2: concat only the 2nd audio track
merge.hintMergeMode: Merging concatenates by re-encoding, so files with different formats or resolutions can be mixed directly; video segments are scaled to the resolution of the first video.
merge.hintAudioTracks: Audio tracks are concatenated by track number and missing tracks are filled with silence; make sure the language track order matches across files. Every track is normalized to 44.1 kHz stereo. Multi-track MP3, FLAC and WAV inputs require an explicit track choice.
merge.errSubtitleRead: Cannot read the timeline from the subtitle file: {{name}}
merge.errSubtitleAudioOnly: An audio-only queue cannot include subtitles; remove the subtitle file first
merge.confirmSubtitleMismatch:
Warning: the subtitle duration ({{subtitle}}) does not match the merged video duration ({{total}}), so the subtitles may drift out of sync.

Continue anyway?

clip.hintDrop: Drop an audio or video file here!

crop.title: Crop - FFGui
crop.heading: Crop
crop.dropHint: Drop a video file here! (only files with a video picture are supported)
crop.canvasHint: Press and drag on the picture to select the area to keep
crop.tip: Pause on the frame you want to crop, then click "Draw crop box" and drag on the picture. You can drag in any direction; the area outside the box is dimmed. The box is stored as a ratio of the picture, independent of preview quality. Output is MP4 / H.264 and width and height are rounded down to even numbers (e.g. 1919→1918). Shortcuts: Space play/pause, Esc clear box.
crop.capsInfo: Always MP4 (H.264 + AAC, 8-bit, all audio tracks and text tags kept); existing files are avoided, never overwritten.
crop.statusPreviewDone: Preview ready (low quality, does not affect output)
crop.overlayPreviewGenerating: The browser cannot play this format directly; generating a low-quality preview…
crop.overlayPreviewUnplayable: Still unable to play this file after generating the preview
crop.overlayPreviewFailed: Preview generation failed; this file cannot be previewed
crop.logUnrecognized: ✘ Unrecognized file (no audio or video stream): {{name}}
crop.logNoVideo: ✘ This file has no video picture and cannot be cropped: {{name}}

disc.title: Disc extraction - FFGui
disc.heading: Disc extraction
disc.typeHintNone: Select a disc type to show the matching tools.
disc.typeVideoDesc: Rip DVD / Blu-ray titles and transcode
disc.typeCdDesc: Rip audio CD tracks to lossless FLAC
disc.typeSwitchRunning: Cannot switch disc type while a task is running.
disc.lblKeydb: Decryption key database (optional, required for encrypted discs, e.g. KEYDB.cfg)
disc.hintSourceSupport: Supports ISO images with a Blu-ray / DVD structure, or folders already extracted to disk (containing BDMV / CERTIFICATE or VIDEO_TS).
disc.hintTitles: Only the longest title (usually the main feature) is selected by default; you can select more. Audio and subtitle tracks can be chosen per title: "All" keeps every track, "None" keeps none, or tick individual tracks.
disc.hintOutput: "Lossless MKV" copies the video stream directly, which is fastest and lossless, but supports MKV only. "Transcode MKV" re-encodes and can keep subtitles. "Transcode MP4" has the best compatibility, but this build keeps no subtitles at all: neither PGS / VobSub image subtitles nor text subtitles are written, so subtitles of every selected title must be set to "None".
